description:
Desktop test bench that runs test-case suites against a local llama.cpp server and compares the runs

A Windows desktop application for evaluating local GGUF models served by llama.cpp. It scans a models folder, starts or attaches to a llama-server on 127.0.0.1:8080, and runs configurable test-case suites covering logic, code, format compliance, instruction following, generation speed and long-context handling. Each answer is graded by an automatic check - substring, regex, JSON schema, code execution, LLM-as-judge or embedding similarity - with skipped checks kept out of the score instead of counted as failures. Runs are stored in a SQLite history with per-case drill-down and side-by-side comparison, and can be exported as an HTML report or printed. Also includes a local agent mode that uses the tested model as a subagent, and reports prefill and generation speed, time to first token, model memory usage and layer placement from the server log.
